notes: Known: Kallat, arXiv:2610.15849 (2026), thm:hanna, Lean proof hanna_conjecture in ahaankallat/congruence-phenomena-higher-order-lean (stated for the weighted-permutation sequence Aw hannaW). Re-derived independently: a(n) counts permutations with cycle lengths in {k^2+1}; conjugation by a p-cycle on {1..p} has fixed set <sigma> x Sym(rest) of size p*a(n-p), so p | a(n). Checked numerically for n <= 449. Outside Lean: the whole argument here (external Lean proof not rechecked; e.g.f. = permutation count by the exponential formula).
